How to become the guy
girls actually notice
Be good with people, not just with girls. The guy who's friendly to everyone, from friends to strangers, is always the one people notice first.
Have a life you're excited about. Sport, projects, travel plans. Passion shows in how you talk and move, and it's naturally attractive.
Dress simply and well. Clean shoes, fitted basics, neutral colours. You don't need to be flashy, just put together. Calm always wins.
Be confident without being loud. Speak calmly, smile easily, don't try to dominate the room. Quiet confidence is noticed more than noise.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Being curious and knowing interesting things makes you great to talk to.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Being curious and knowing interesting things makes you great to talk to.

slides.texte_overlay: Be the friend who makes plans. Organise the dinner, the trip, the game night. People notice the guy who brings everyone together.
Respect her answer, always. Say hello, be friendly, and if she isn't interested, smile and move on. Respect is what makes a good impression last.
